Approach

Real partnership. Real impact.

I coach because I know the toll that growing behind the pace of organizations takes on leaders. I came up inside organizations running HR and talent strategy through hypergrowth, layoffs, leadership transitions, and the kind of ambiguity that doesn't fit in a framework.

When you work with me, you get a partner, coach, and an operator who understands organizational reality and won't let you stay comfortable with a story that isn't serving you anymore.

Right Fit

Who this is actually for.

You're good at your job. You've been good at it for a while. Something shifted.

This isn't for people who need to be taught how to lead. It's for people who already know how, and have reached the point where more information isn't what's missing.

1

You've been promoted into a role your track record hasn't fully prepared you for.

2

You're running a bigger mandate the way you ran the old one, and you can feel the gap.

3

You're at a transition or decision point and need real space to think it through.

4

You've been losing perspective to the role, and you want it back.

    Work Together

    Three ways to engage.

    For the long haul

    Leadership Retainer

    Inquire for pricing

    Most engagements start with an executive about what challenges they or their leaders are tackling, and what elevating their leadership unlocks for the rest of the company. I coach those leaders one-on-one, every other week, with access between sessions when the moment heats up. You can bring me in for one leader or several.

    • 6 months, every other week
    • 3-month minimum
    • One leader or several
    Start a conversation →
    For rapid change

    The Coaching Sprint

    $2,500 · 6 spots at a time

    Five sessions over about six weeks, focused on one challenge: a decision you're avoiding, a pattern you keep repeating, a leadership moment you feel but can't quite see clearly. We dig into it, hard, until something breaks open. It starts with a free intro call, and we book every session before we hang up.

    • Intake + 5 sessions + 30-day check-in
    • About 6 weeks

    Want to keep going? Sprint clients who continue within 30 days can roll into a six-month engagement at a reduced rate.

    Book a sprint intro call →
    For a known people challenge

    Talent Advisory

    Scoped to the work

    Coaching helps you find your own way through a challenge. Advisory is different. When you have a known gap in your people infrastructure, like a performance process that isn't working, a team structure that no longer fits, or a leadership bench you need to build, you need someone who has built it before. I bring the expertise and the work itself, scoped to what you need and delivered on a clear timeline.

    • Scoped to the work
    • Clear deliverables and timeline
    Talk through your challenge →
    About

    Andrew Smith

    Founder, The Rockwell Fellowship

    I led People and HR teams at scaling companies, including high-growth startups and Fortune 500 organizations. I've been in the room when the organization restructures. I've run the layoff. I've watched capable leaders get smaller as their companies got larger, and helped them find their way back. I've done that work quietly for years. The Rockwell Fellowship is where I do it out loud.

    I'm Georgetown-certified in executive coaching and ICF credentialed - PCC. More importantly, I've coached leaders externally for years, and recently internally as a senior HR leader with an operator’s experience. I know the impact leaders have when they break through what’s holding them back and their teams and businesses flourish as a result.

    I'm honest, direct, and I’m in your corner. I won’t just tell you what you want to hear. I'll push you to grow.

    Georgetown-Certified Executive Coach ICF Professional Certified Coach (PCC) M.S. Industrial-Organizational Psychology
